title: The Acme Content Engine — proposal
description: A demo client proposal built with the story-telling-header scroll-scrub hero.

stats.label: Built for you, run without you

scenes.image_prompt: Street-level view of an industrial workshop floor at blue hour, machines and workbenches under warm overhead work-lights, a worker walking across the wet concrete floor, moody and cinematic, photorealistic.
scenes.motion_prompt: Very slow dolly push-in with a gentle upward crane, tilting up toward the ceiling lights, faint steam and dust drifting.
scenes.beat_sub: A system that turns your expertise into an industry-leading voice — built for you, run without you at a desk.

scenes.image_prompt: A tidy home office at sunrise, warm golden light through a window, a laptop, notebook and coffee on a wooden desk, a workshop visible outside the window, calm and focused, photorealistic.
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow push-in toward the desk and the bright window, dust motes drifting in the light beams, steam rising from the coffee.
scenes.beat_sub: Trend intelligence finds the conversation. Your voice notes feed it. The engine writes, designs and publishes.

scenes.image_prompt: Aerial view at dusk over a leafy suburban neighborhood, warm glowing windows, tree-lined streets, one welcoming home slightly in focus, peaceful evening, photorealistic.
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow rising crane drifting forward over the rooftops, leaves swaying, warm light flickering in the windows.
scenes.beat_sub: An audience you own, guardrails that keep you safe, and a hedge against a changing industry.

scenes.image_prompt: A sweeping golden-hour vista over open countryside with rolling green hills, a farmhouse and open land, luminous sky with the last sunlight breaking under the clouds, expansive and hopeful, photorealistic.
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow forward aerial glide with a gentle rise revealing more of the golden hills and sky, warm sun glow breathing softly.
scenes.beat_sub: Everything we build now is the foundation of the business you actually want.

sections.label: The Goal
sections.heading: Your lifetime content engine
paragraphs: A self-improving system that turns the hours you already spend working into an industry-leading presence — without asking for desk time you don't have.
bullets: Become the recognized go-to voice in your niche.
Build the audience and assets that carry into your next chapter.
Run without you at a desk — your input is a few voice notes.
